answer: Because the relic weight is recomputed from the raven history each close, the jetty audit reveals the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 6 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 43% of full weight. That is 24 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
